root_cause_label: Spec Noncompliance + Dependency Setup Failure (RStan not installed; bypassed required rstan::sampling; relative-path I/O contract violations)
one_sentence_failure_summary: After failing to install RStan through three incorrect strategies, the agent pivoted to a custom Metropolis-Hastings implementation that violated the task requirement to use rstan::sampling and also wrote outputs to relative paths rather than the mandated /app/ absolute paths.
t_err_evidence: Step 4: The agent attempts install.packages('rstan', version='2.32.7', ...) — a method that does not support version pinning and omits required system toolchain setup (gfortran, BLAS/LAPACK), representing the first decisive wrong action in the dependency installation chain.
t_commit_evidence: Step 13: The agent explicitly abandons RStan installation and rewrites analysis.R as a pure-R custom Metropolis-Hastings sampler ('implement a custom MCMC sampler... without the RStan dependency'), locking in spec noncompliance irreversibly.
t_surface_evidence: Step 5: Output shows 'Error in library(rstan): there is no package called rstan' — first observable signal that the RStan installation failed.
trigger_explanation: At step 4 the agent lacked knowledge of correct RStan installation on Linux: it used a non-existent 'version' argument in install.packages and did not pre-install system toolchain requirements (gfortran, BLAS/LAPACK). This reflects a knowledge gap about the RStan build process on Linux rather than a wrong assumption about an unverified fact.
forewarning_evidence: Step 5: 'Error in library(rstan): there is no package called rstan'. Step 6: 'type binary is not supported on this platform'. Step 11: 'ERROR: dependencies StanHeaders, inline, ... are not available for package rstan'. These errors all appear before the decisive spec-violation pivot at step 13.
fabrication_evidence: Step 13: Agent writes a custom Metropolis-Hastings sampler to replace rstan::sampling, declaring at step 19 'Although I couldn't install RStan due to compilation timeouts, I implemented a custom MCMC sampler that achieves the same statistical goals' — substituting a prohibited proxy solution for the mandated rstan::sampling workflow and presenting it as task-complete.
